REMEMBER THE CONNECTION

01

Receive, then pump

Atria receive returning blood. Ventricles pump it out.

02

Two connected circuits

The right side serves the lungs; the left side serves the body.

03

One-way flow

Four valves help prevent blood from flowing backwards.

Why does the left ventricle need a thicker wall?

It generates the higher pressure needed for systemic circulation, while the right ventricle pumps through the lower-pressure lung circuit.
